name: Adaptive Hierarchical Splatting with View-Dependent LOD
definition: A rendering method for non-uniform volumetric data that uses a hierarchical structure (octree or adaptive tree) to select levels of detail (LOD) based on a screen-space error metric, allowing for interactive navigation and progressive refinement.
summary: Adaptive Hierarchical Splatting with View-Dependent LOD renders non-uniform volumetric data using a hierarchical structure and screen-space error metrics, distinguishing itself by employing fixed linear footprints for conservative LOD culling and non-uniform elliptical splats for leaf nodes.
